tasks.subject: Task 1: release_freeze module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Self-contained module implementing drain, all-green assertion, build-flag freeze with exact-meta restore, and post-release binary landing verification.

**Files:**
- Create: `percona_obs/release_freeze.py`
- Test: `tests/test_release_freeze.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `fetch_project_results` parses a `_result` XML into per-package codes and per-repo states (dirty attr wins).
- [ ] `wait_for_quiesce` returns once nothing is pending and raises SystemExit on timeout naming pending items.
- [ ] `assert_all_green` returns [] for succeeded/excluded/disabled-only and a problem list `project/pkg repo/arch: code` otherwise.
- [ ] `freeze_builds` snapshots exact meta then applies blanket build-disable (replacing any existing build element); `restore_builds` pushes snapshots back verbatim, never raises.
- [ ] `verify_release_landed` polls until target package set covers source's; SystemExit with missing list on timeout.

**Verify:** venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_release_freeze.py -q; venv/bin/black percona_obs/ && venv/bin/pyright

```json:metadata
{"files": ["percona_obs/release_freeze.py", "tests/test_release_freeze.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_release_freeze.py -q && venv/bin/black --check percona_obs/ && venv/bin/pyright", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fetch_project_results parses codes+states", "wait_for_quiesce returns/timeouts correctly", "assert_all_green green-set and problem list", "freeze snapshots + blanket disable, restore verbatim never raises", "verify_release_landed coverage poll + timeout"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: sync release freeze sequence + landing verification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** sync release drains staging, asserts green, freezes builds around osc release, restores exact meta in a finally, verifies packages landed; CLI knobs --no-freeze/--freeze-timeout/--verify-timeout.

**Files:**
- Modify: `percona_obs/cmd_sync.py` (cmd_sync_release), `percona_obs/cli.py`
- Test: `tests/test_sync_release.py` (extend)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Order: wait_for_quiesce -> assert_all_green (SystemExit on problems) -> freeze_builds, all BEFORE _add_release_targets; restore_builds in finally around the whole release+subproject phase.
- [ ] Freeze scope = source project + all subprojects from _collect_release_subprojects; missing-mirror check precedes freezing.
- [ ] verify_release_landed runs for top-level + every subproject pair after release; --verify-timeout 0 disables; --no-freeze skips gate but still verifies.
- [ ] Flags: --no-freeze, --freeze-timeout (default 3600), --verify-timeout (default 600).

**Verify:** venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_sync_release.py -q; full suite passes

```json:metadata
{"files": ["percona_obs/cmd_sync.py", "percona_obs/cli.py", "tests/test_sync_release.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_sync_release.py -q && venv/bin/black --check percona_obs/ && venv/bin/pyright", "acceptanceCriteria": ["drain->green->freeze order before targets", "restore in finally even on failure", "verification per project pair", "CLI flags wired"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 14: dev-OBS release rehearsal (USER GATE)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the whole v2 release path end-to-end against the dev OBS before trusting the CI path.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- None (verification only; -P dev, NEVER -P isv)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] sync release --dry-run exits 0 on a prepared scratch release tree (output shows 'release dry-run passed').
- [ ] Full sync release run completes: drain line, '(builds frozen)' per project, 'released' lines for top level + every subproject, 'packages landed' lines, '(builds restored)' per project.
- [ ] Source project meta on dev OBS byte-identical before vs after (empty diff of /source/<prj>/_meta captures).
- [ ] A deliberately broken rehearsal (red package or removed mirror) aborts with the documented hard error, builds end unfrozen/restored.

**Verify:** venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P dev sync release <scratch-release-project> --dry-run && venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P dev sync release <scratch-release-project>; captured outputs for all four criteria; scratch commits reverted.
